master-plans-portuarios.title: Port master plans
master-plans-portuarios.description: Master plans and long-term plans that structure the growth of ports and terminals over a 10 to 30 year horizon.
master-plans-portuarios.longDescription: A competitive port is planned decades in advance. At DOMINUS we support port authorities and operators in the preparation of master plans, long-term plans and expansion studies, integrating demand analysis, infrastructure sizing, operational layout, and environmental and financial assessment. Our goal is to deliver an implementable plan: with prioritized phases, realistic investment budget and a workable financing scheme.
deliverables: Demand study by cargo segment and traffic projections.
General layout and zoning plans.
Phased investment plan (CAPEX / OPEX).
Cost-benefit analysis and economic-financial assessment.
Implementation roadmap and risk matrix.

concesiones-ppp-licitaciones.title: Concessions, PPP and tenders
concesiones-ppp-licitaciones.description: Structuring of concession processes, public-private schemes and tenders with clear rules and robust contracts.
concesiones-ppp-licitaciones.longDescription: Attracting private investment to the port sector requires contractual structures that balance the public interest, the operator's economic sustainability and long-term legal certainty. At DOMINUS we design and support concession, PPP and tender processes for terminals, services and port works, from feasibility analysis through contract signing and the launch of regulatory monitoring.
deliverables: Technical, economic and legal feasibility studies.
Business model design and risk matrix.
Bidding documents, contracts and technical annexes.
Data room and support during the Q&A round.
Bid evaluation and support during award.

gobernanza-y-tarifas.title: Governance and tariffs
gobernanza-y-tarifas.description: Redesign of port governance models and tariff schemes to align incentives, efficiency and competitiveness.
gobernanza-y-tarifas.longDescription: Governance and tariff policy are two of the most powerful —and most underestimated— levers of port performance. We help authorities and boards diagnose their institutional model (landlord, tool port, service port, hybrid models), redesign the organizational structure and build a tariff schedule that finances operations, remunerates investment and does not erode competitiveness against neighboring ports.
deliverables: Institutional diagnosis and international benchmarking.
Proposed governance model and organizational structure.
Tariff schedule with methodology and technical rationale.
Internal rules and procedure manuals.
Transition and implementation plan.

optimizacion-operativa-terminales.title: Terminal operational optimization
optimizacion-operativa-terminales.description: Operational diagnostics and improvement plans to raise productivity, reduce dwell times and leverage existing infrastructure.
optimizacion-operativa-terminales.longDescription: Before investing in more infrastructure, many terminals can gain capacity by optimizing what they already have. At DOMINUS we carry out operational diagnostics of container, bulk and multipurpose terminals, measure productivity KPIs (BMPH, dwell time, yard utilization, gate turnaround), identify bottlenecks and design concrete improvement plans with measurable impact on times, costs and service level to shipping lines.
deliverables: Operational diagnosis with KPI measurement.
Bottleneck map and root-cause analysis.
Improvement plan prioritized by impact and effort.
Process redesign, yard layouts and equipment cycles.
Indicator dashboard for continuous monitoring.

transformacion-digital-pcs.title: Digital transformation and PCS
transformacion-digital-pcs.description: Strategy and roadmap for port digitalization, including Port Community Systems, TOS and single window.
transformacion-digital-pcs.longDescription: Digitalization is no longer optional for the port sector. We support ports and terminals in defining their digital strategy, selecting and implementing Port Community Systems (PCS), Terminal Operating Systems (TOS), port single windows and electronic data exchange platforms with the logistics community. We work with a business-architecture approach: processes first, technology second.
deliverables: Digital maturity diagnosis and benchmark.
Digital transformation strategy and roadmap.
Business cases and functional specifications for PCS/TOS.
Support during vendor selection processes.
Change management and adoption with the port community.

sostenibilidad-y-green-ports.title: Sustainability and green ports
sostenibilidad-y-green-ports.description: Environmental sustainability strategies and decarbonization plans aligned with international green port standards.
sostenibilidad-y-green-ports.longDescription: Ports are critical nodes for the energy transition and for meeting regional climate commitments. We help port authorities and terminals build their environmental sustainability strategy, measure their carbon footprint, design decarbonization plans (shore power, cold ironing, alternative fuels) and align management with international frameworks such as ESI, EcoPorts and IMO guidelines.
deliverables: GHG emissions inventory (port Scope 1, 2 and 3).
Decarbonization plan with targets and roadmap.
Air, water and waste management strategy.
Alignment with international standards (ESI, EcoPorts, IMO).
Sustainability report and stakeholder communication.

regulacion-y-politicas-publicas.title: Regulation and public policy
regulacion-y-politicas-publicas.description: Design and evaluation of port public policies, regulatory frameworks and reforms of the national port system.
regulacion-y-politicas-publicas.longDescription: The performance of a port system depends, to a large extent, on the quality of its regulatory framework. We advise ministries, port authorities and regulatory bodies on the design of public policies, regulatory reforms, port laws and sector regulations. We combine technical, legal and institutional analysis to produce instruments that are clear, viable and legitimate among the sector's actors.
deliverables: Diagnosis of the current regulatory framework and international benchmarking.
Draft laws, decrees and regulations.
Regulatory impact analysis (RIA).
Design of oversight and supervision schemes.
Public consultation strategy and consensus building.

capacitacion-y-talento.title: Training and port talent
capacitacion-y-talento.description: Executive and technical training programs for port authorities, boards and port operator teams.
capacitacion-y-talento.longDescription: The best policies and the best contracts require teams prepared to carry them forward. At DOMINUS we design tailor-made training programs for port authority boards, terminal management and public-sector technical areas. Our programs blend solid conceptual frameworks, internationally comparable case studies and exercises applied to each institution's real challenges.
deliverables: Training needs assessment.
Curriculum design and original didactic materials.
In-person and virtual workshops (in-company).
Executive programs for boards and senior management.
Certifications and training impact evaluation.

hero.title: Meet DOMINUS
hero.subtitle: A consultancy specialized in port development, with a team built inside the sector.

intro.title: A team with port craft serving port authorities and terminals worldwide
intro.paragraph1: DOMINUS is a consulting firm specialized in port system development worldwide. We were founded to address a specific gap: the need for independent technical and institutional advisory, with real port craft and a bias for implementation, both for public port authorities and private terminals.
intro.paragraph2: Our team was built inside the sector: port authority management, terminal operations, regulation and infrastructure planning. That background lets us understand problems from the inside, speak our clients' language and produce solutions that can actually be put in motion — not just polished diagnoses.

reach.title: Projects across leading port systems worldwide
reach.description: Our accumulated experience covers port authorities, container, bulk and multipurpose terminals, and regulatory bodies in multiple countries worldwide. That track record gives us a living bank of comparative cases that enriches every new project.
